notes: Each stage scales by its own work: label and evidence per text sent, verify per sampled text, group per complaint or cancellation record. The memo is one-time work.
Tokens and seconds per unit are measured on the 100-review pilot at one worker. Elapsed time divides by max_concurrency and is modeled, not measured.
retry_fraction: base 0.02 is the pilot's 2 quote failures in 100; conservative is 0.10.
fallback_fraction: no stronger fallback model is configured. The conservative case reserves 5% of evidence work at 10 times the evidence cost.
verify_fraction 0.10 is the pilot's 10-review verifier sample.
complaint_fraction: base 0.3033 is the main run (30,400 of 100,229 accepted); conservative 0.51 is the pilot (51 of 100).
With exact_text_reuse, 484,189 distinct texts are sent; without it, all 660,609 nonempty texts. The 13 empty texts are quarantined with no call.
Local compute cost is unknown, not zero.
